newsitem.title: UK: UK Channel 5 to show Poland-England soccer live.
newsitem.headline: UK Channel 5 to show Poland-England soccer live.

text.p: Britain's new Channel 5 television station said on Wednesday it had secured the live rights to the Poland-England World Cup soccer qualifier on May 31.
Channel 5 will also screen the Argentina versus England rugby union international live on the same day as part of a sporting double-bill.
Channel 5, Britain's fifth terrestrial television channel, plans to launch on March 30.
"Channel 5 is committed to broadcasting spectacular one-off sporting events of this kind. This double whammy was too good to ignore," said Nick Wilson, the channel's controller of sport.
Channel 5, a consortium comprising Pearson, United News & Media, CLT of Luxembourg and U.S. investment firm Warburg Pincus, said the matches were acquired as part of a two-year deal with CSI Ltd.

It said the package also included a series of hourly sports specials and a South American soccer show including big games from Brazil and America. That action will run in Channel 5's late night sports show.
